facts.fact: TechAfrica News reports on 11 Sep 2025 the launch of Cape Verde's National Strategy for 5G, with a target of 90% internet penetration by 2026 and regional hub status by 2030, without stating that it had been adopted.
facts.system: Estratégia Nacional para a Implementação da Tecnologia 5G

facts.fact: The strategy is led by the Ministry of Digital Economy as part of the World Bank-funded Cape Verde Digital Project and implemented through DGTED, per TechAfrica News.
facts.system: Estratégia Nacional para a Implementação da Tecnologia 5G
